description: SPEC-0128: repair + re-score every GLB / glTF under the given files/dirs (recursive), writing each repaired asset + a per-asset report into out_dir, plus a roll-up that tallies readiness status transitions (not-ready→ready/warnings), how many assets were rescued, how many remain not-ready, and total size reduction. The agency / generator catalog surface. Set bake_usdz_safe=false to keep lossy materials.

bake_usdz_safe.description: Flatten USDZ-lossy materials so AR Quick Look renders. Default true.

inputs.description: Files and/or directories (sandbox-relative; dirs are walked recursively for .glb/.gltf).

out_dir.description: Destination directory for repaired assets + reports (sandbox-relative).

name: batch_autocorrect
title: Autocorrect a whole catalog for commerce readiness
